description: This file defines the FirstScreen widget in a Flutter application, which is the initial screen prompting users for location and phone permissions. It includes UI layout code with icons, text, and a button that triggers permission requests and navigates to the SecondScreen.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the initial screen for new users, requesting location and phone permissions, with a custom UI layout.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the FirstScreen widget.

methods.name: _FirstScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the Flutter UI for the screen, including icons, text, and the permission button.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Creates a row with an icon and descriptive text for permissions.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Handles the permission request process and navigates to the next screen.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Requests location permission, updates preferences, and navigates to SecondScreen.
